label: late "e" input in sequences starting with o/i/a
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase (96% of mass) at late positions (t=5-8, mostly the last 1-3 tokens before <DEL>), and mostly on the input token e (79% of mass, 23x lift). Gets a small spillover at <DEL> (4%). Never fires in the copy phase or at t<4. It is strongly gated by sequence context: the first original token being o (12x lift), i or a, and earlier vowels (o/i/u) or the digit 3 in the prefix. The top activations are e at the last original positions after prefixes like o i u l 3. Magnitude is larger for later e and vowel-heavy prefixes. Even so, most late e inputs (about 97%) do not activate it, so the context condition is only partly captured. The best predicate, e at t>=6 with first token in {o,i,a}, reaches dev F1 0.28 and mass recall 0.47. Plain late e (t>=5) gets mass recall 0.79 but precision 0.03.
